desc:
🚀 Welcome to Bathroom Tower Defense 2!
🌟 WEEKLY UPDATES GALORE! Get ready for exciting additions and challenges EVERY SATURDAY! Like the game for more updates!! 
🤝 Play with friends to earn coins easier! 
💰 Spend Coins on summon! (lobby) to unlock new characters!
🔥 Place down your characters and defeat waves of enemies to earn coins! 💰 
👑 Premium Players get +1 Coins in the AFK Area! 
🍀 Join group for +1 Luck 

*Console* 
[Lobby] Look at player and click R2 to see units! 
[In-game] Look at unit and click R2 to see stats!
